title: rsdv: Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Gaussian Copulas
summary: A CRAN package generating synthetic tabular data from Gaussian copula models, with parametric marginal selection for numerical columns and a cumulative-frequency embedding that folds categorical and boolean columns into the same joint copula. It is an independent R reimplementation of SDV rather than a port: the description names the Python library and cites the DSAA'16 paper, and the S3 classes mirror SDV's API surface directly, including a metadata system, constraints and a quality report carrying Column Pair Trends and TVD similarity. SDV's design crossing into a second language ecosystem, as kasaai/ctgan did for CTGAN.
affiliations: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
evidence: CRAN description names the Python SDV library and cites Patki, Wedge and Veeramachaneni (2016); reference manual shows rsdv_metadata, rsdv_constraint and rsdv_quality_report mirroring SDV's API. Not a code port.

title: TabularQGAN: a quantum generative model for tabular data synthesis
summary: Proposes a quantum generative model for tabular synthesis, arguing that enterprise data is predominantly tabular and therefore the natural target for early quantum advantage. CTGAN and CopulaGAN are the classical baselines it is measured against, so SDV defines the bar a quantum method has to clear, from an industrial chemistry lab rather than an academic group.

title: A mixture of attention experts-embedded flow-based generative model to create synthetic cells in single-cell RNA-Seq datasets
summary: Proposes two flow-based generators for synthesizing cells in single-cell RNA sequencing, aimed at the rare cell types that scRNAseq analysis most wants to characterise. Gaussian Copula is one of the comparison models, so SDV's statistical synthesizer serves as the conventional baseline against a flow architecture.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula is one of the comparison models for two proposed flow-based generators

title: IAR-Net: Tabular Deep Learning Model for Interventionalist's Action Recognition
summary: Recognises catheterization actions from tabular sensor features to give interventionalists objective, immediate feedback in place of subjective assessment. Six generative models are evaluated to expand the training set, and the abstract singles out CTGAN as the exception to otherwise high fidelity scores, which makes this one of the few entries recording a negative result for an SDV synthesizer.

SynQP benchmarks CTGAN and proposes a new identity disclosure risk metric, so SDV is the system a government-authored evaluation framework is calibrated against.

title: Machine Learning-Based Malware Classification in Real-Time IoT Scenarios
summary: Classifies malware families in real time across 5G, IoT and intelligent transportation infrastructure, where rare families are the ones detection most needs. The Synthetic Data Vault and SMOTE are the two augmentation techniques compared, putting the library directly against the classical oversampler on the same task.
